title: Agent goal / instruction integrity — Splunk hunt (schema 1.9.0)
schema.name: agentsec.security_event
schema_version_note: LAB-MCP-001 Q-MCP-*.spl does not filter schema.version and is 1.9.0-compatible. This hunt is schema-version agnostic in SPL. Q-MCP-DELEGATION is NOT APPLICABLE (CTRL-DELEGATION-001 / ambient_deputy).

queries.security_question: For this run: what authoritative task was assigned, what untrusted instruction was observed, what task change was proposed, what did CTRL-GOAL-INTEGRITY-001 decide, what became the effective action, what did CTRL-MCP-001 decide, and was execution observed?

queries_not_created.reason: Authoritative task id/hash/provenance are columns on Q-GOAL-INTEGRITY-AUTHORITY.
instruction.trust and bounded GOAL preview (instruction_hash) are columns on Q-GOAL-INTEGRITY-AUTHORITY.
REUSED: Q-MCP-TOOL, Q-MCP-EXECUTED, and execution_observation on Q-GOAL-INTEGRITY-AUTHORITY.
NOT APPLICABLE. That hunt requires CTRL-DELEGATION-001 / ambient_deputy (MCP-006).

detection.note: Reused unchanged. DET-GOAL not created. Overlay reason and AGENT NOTE are LAB-ONLY, not production IOCs.
